subject: TASK-007 最终 G2 产品源码的 G4 同范围复证；原门槛判线与历史run保持，增加明确的新协调者/owner/仪器回归绑定
hypothesis: 同一固定提交的真实OIS/OIC/oi在SQLite3.54.1和PostgreSQL18.6满足TV-B3-11a–i及TV-B3-02/04/10回归，零容忍为零，完整既有向量集和产品质量门槛通过：单测≥95%、race、主动fuzz、vet、staticcheck、govulncheck。
alternatives: 只在一个后端恢复成功
恢复静默重启已撤销Access、在管理员resume前放行Open或复用旧term
导出/导入丢失或改变数据且摘要未检出，拒绝导入留下半成品
存储仍失败却报恢复，满盘/只读仍放行Open
拥塞变成无界排队而非快速拒绝
tmpfs或pg_dump/pg_restore路径被跳过造成表面通过
disproof: 任一必需后端/向量fail或skip（包括tmpfs上的TV-B3-11e及TV-B3-11a/b/c的pg_dump/pg_restore）、任一ZERO-TOLERANCE、既有向量失败、完整覆盖率低于95%、race报告或主动fuzz/静态/安全工具失败均反驳本提交假设；缺失或超时步骤为inconclusive，不得pass。
limitations: 显式local-isolated-vm-v1的专用Ubuntu 24.04 VM单机回环；不是G5目标整机或WAN延迟证据。
磁盘满采用32MiB tmpfs，PostgreSQL只读采用default_transaction_read_only；真实磁盘、配额与存储故障可能表现不同。
PostgreSQL备份使用本地guest内与server同版本18.6的pg_dump/pg_restore二进制（OI_IT_PG_BIN）；不声称使用旧CI服务容器。pg_basebackup与时间点恢复仍属本run之外的部署程序。
备份、恢复、迁移与维护时长/大小仅为B4§6小测试库观察，无额外判线；不是G5/G6容量或RTO/RPO承诺。
本G4直接证明范围不包括G6高可用、G2探针、G3真实路径故障或G7真实应用兼容。
旧scope中P1的unknown/无probe或G4不覆盖G2，限定原直接向量范围；本源码包含G2且整包可附带执行其普通Go测试，追加writer/admission/clock及竞争仪器也不替代G2正式130叶行为、20×20真实钟、资源及fairness同run复算。
新增clock根只是普通纯仪器测试，OI_IT_CLOCK=0；不得在本G1/G4工作流运行真实跳钟或声称其400轮通过。G3仍需最终同源独立manifest及正式复证。
全部原criteria映射、原vector逐项、load有无及值、resource结构、步骤/模糊测试和质量阈值保持；新增回归的missing/skip/fail同样令整体不通过，不靠新ID更换原门槛。
仅执行接线：vectors_timeout_minutes=90明确Go90m/collector5700s，旧manifest缺省40m仍保持；宿主监督器保持150m共享硬上限，各step不能保证同时用满。任何超限不通过，所有产品500ms/3s/60s及资源/质量判线保持。
本显式资源变体相对于无resources的比较候选，仅接入既有B4原始资源判线与其验收仪器：79叶/85最少cleanup、原2s、精确FD、goroutine±10、三连续完整样本；不改变原四项产品criteria、unit/race、load或其他阈值。
本文件为运行前固定的本地预注册；实际被测subject_version必须为包含本文件和已审实现的完整清洁Git提交，并与root attestation、原始env/source及宿主最终回执一致。仅local-isolated-vm-v1、固定官方漏洞库快照及本次专用VM启动适用；不伪造GitHub-hosted来源，不外推G5性能。原失败、历史run与分析器保持。
宿主监督器总预算为150分钟（9000s）；这是共享执行上限，不延长任何产品/步骤判线，不保证各步骤同时用满。恢复与保存按既有独立清理流程记录，不能把迟到执行改判为通过。

case.scope: 同一专用隔离Linux VM上的真实OIS/OIC/oi与SQLite/PostgreSQL；B3§8恢复工具及§8.1.1维护，使用32MiB tmpfs和本地同版本pg_dump/pg_restore。不直接证明G5目标整机、G6高可用、G2探针、G3路径故障或G7真实应用兼容。

vectors.note: store contract: exactly one of two concurrent writes wins
regression: restart ends old channels and tickets
regression: OIC reports raise the epoch after an older database
SQLite on a 32 MiB tmpfs; PostgreSQL read-only
WAL and checkpoints are SQLite mechanisms
store recovery contract on both backends

excluded.TV-B4-02: Windows default code page F0 regression; covered by the Windows CI job
excluded.TV-B4-06: O3 load profile of G1; not part of G4 (load is false)

excluded.TestTVB4_01_ReproducibleBuild: Build reproducibility has no running OIS/OIC topology; unit-store vectors run inside the unit-test process and are covered by their unchanged original vector results.

rules.topology: OIS accesses_online equals its baseline; every expected OIC connected/registered with positive epoch/generation; no access-count/OIC-count equivalence
rules.identity: PID positive and stable within a check; a restarted role may differ from its original baseline PID
rules.other_records: Validate every emitted resource record, including G4 records outside the required G1 test list.
rules.baselines: G1 uses one initial profile per test, never a new profile after its first check; B1-17 may add only lab-f before that check while keeping the original OIS snapshot exact. Extra migration profiles reuse the exact first snapshot of each (test, role, PID); new reference PIDs must first appear before that test begins any cleanup check.
rules.sampling: Each sample has positive duration, follows the previous sample without overlap, and all role timestamps are inside its interval; identical instantaneous observations cannot count as three samples.

supersedes_for_current_source: G4-P2-R3：只对包含本预注册的最终固定 G2 源码重新核验；不覆盖旧run、旧判线或历史结论。
